scenario_analysis.acceptance: not a CPI reaction trade; the oil-specific decline held through the release (about 84.59 near 12:00Z, CNBC context; 84.358 at 15:05Z), with the dossier capture (run started 09:30:56Z) at 83.872, already under the 9 Nov low 84.237.

base_case.market_move: WTI's own supply-and-peace liquidation continues, a bounce fails under the broken 4-5 Nov lows 86.02-86.59, and WTI falls back to about lower levels, just above the 31 Aug low 83.364, before 13 Nov 08:00Z.

scenario_analysis.confirmations: (1) the captured -1.39% against the USD's sign; (2) the break of the 9 Nov D1 low 84.237 (83.872 at the dossier capture); (3) -15.40% over ten sessions with no D1 close back above 86.02 since 9 Nov.
scenario_analysis.driver: CLEAR for oil's own channel; no measured CPI channel; 20-day correlation -0.55 to US500 and -0.05 to US10Y changes.
scenario_analysis.invalidation_reason: 86.15 sits above the broken 5 Nov D1 low 86.02 (the 4 Nov low 86.59 is next); a trade there means the bounce has reclaimed broken support.
scenario_analysis.invalidation_text: any trade above 86.15; the thesis is also broken by an M15 close above 86.02, a confirmed Saudi export outage from the pipeline attack, or a collapse of the Iran talks.

main_alternative.market_move: a supply-shock squeeze from the stretched low, such as damage from the Houthi strike on the Saudi East-West pipeline, lifts WTI above 86.15 before 13 Nov 08:00Z.

scenario_analysis.mechanism: oil's own driver, not CPI: WTI fell 1.39% today while the USD rose, against its +0.30 20-day DXY correlation (DXY beta +3.05), and fell 4.42% on the USD-down 9 Nov; the stated cause, the war and supply premium unwinding (Brent under 90, remarks that the Iran war could end 'fairly soon', Hormuz flows largely recovered; CNBC and ING, context), has no admitted row; the October CPI energy component (+0.7% m/m, gasoline +1.0%) reflects past oil at 98-104.
scenario_analysis.opposite_mechanism: a squeeze from the stretched low on a supply headline (the Houthi strike on Saudi East-West pipeline pumping stations, 14:12Z, context) or a reversal of the peace narrative inside the horizon.
scenario_analysis.positioning: WTI speculators net long 80,289 (324,523 long vs 244,234 short) with 594,556 spreading of 1,908,732 open interest (COT 3 Nov at a 95.77 close; today's length not observed after a further -12%); flow levels are the broken 9 Nov low 84.237 and the 31 Aug low 83.364. Crowd trade: selling oil after -15% in ten days, wrong on a supply-shock squeeze through 86.02-86.59.
scenario_analysis.priced: prior_pricing AMBIGUOUS; 10-day -15.40%, 5-day -2.62 ATR (3 Nov close 95.77 to 9 Nov 85.547; ATR 3.896); the capture sits -3.17 ATR under the 20-day mean 96.72, -2.57 under the 50-day 94.36 and -1.12 under the 200-day 88.74; 20-day z -2.09; 20-day range 84.237-104.037; ATR percentile 55.8; the dossier's CPI event matrix had no WTI cell; implied move not observed.
scenario_analysis.why_no_open: the capture 84.358 sits 0.89-1.14 under the reviewed selling zone at a -2.09 z-score; selling there sells an exhausted low (the Gemini 06:53Z concern).
scenario_analysis.zone_reason: 85.25-85.50 retests the 1 Sep D1 low 85.271, the 05:00Z H1 high 85.353 (06:52Z ledger) and the 9 Nov close 85.547, under the broken 4-5 Nov lows.
